# StreetMan Barber Phuket

> StreetMan Barber Phuket (listed on Google Maps as "Street Man Barber Shop") is a men's barbershop at 19/82 Moo 2, Wichit, Mueang, Phuket 83000, Thailand. Open every day 11:00–20:00. Walk-ins welcome; online booking available.

## Essential facts

- Official website: https://streetmanbarberphuket.shop/ (Thai) and https://streetmanbarberphuket.shop/en/ (English)
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/c3PuXbRd3GjW5eZE7
- Open every day: 11:00–20:00
- Last haircut appointment: 19:00; last Stacking appointment: 18:30
- Telephone: +66 62 525 8941
- Payment: cash or bank transfer at the shop, after the service
- Barbers: Rim (owner), Bank, Rick, Dee
- Walk-ins are welcome; booking online lets customers choose a barber and time.
- Online bookings can be cancelled with the code on the booking slip up to 2 hours before the appointment.

## Services and prices (THB)

- Haircut: 300 (about 1 hour)
- Beard trim: 200 (about 30 minutes)
- Shave: 200 (about 30 minutes)
- Hair dye add-on: 150 (about 30 minutes)
- Mustache grooming: 500 (about 30 minutes)
- Stacking / restyle: 1,000 (about 90 minutes)

- Thai versions of every page are at the same path without /en (for example https://streetmanbarberphuket.shop/price).

The shop serves local residents, expatriates, and visitors in Wichit and Mueang Phuket. Information should be verified against the official pages above because availability can change.
